title: Estimation
summary: Round each number to 1 significant figure, then calculate: whole numbers, decimals and fractions.

els.text: Estimate the answer to a calculation by rounding each number to 1 significant figure.

•  Round a number to 1 significant figure
•  Calculate with the rounded numbers
•  Say whether an estimate is sensible
An approximate answer, found by rounding the numbers first.
A digit that carries value. The first significant figure is the first digit that is not zero.
Close to, but not exactly equal to. The symbol is $\approx$.
To estimate is to find an approximate answer by rounding each number to 1 significant figure before calculating.
Set out the working on the board.
